craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of fitted joinery — utsāha as qualifier meets qualified without loss. Helping relation admitted (for helpings sake): generosity inside rigor — serves-to-know end. Rejected: (a) cutting helping as digression → killed: admission is architecture. (b) sake→purpose → killed: L3 frozen. Read aloud: SO there IS-al-SO an-OTH-er — QUAL-i-fi-er WITH-qual-i-FIED … IT-serves TO-know.

lines: So there is also another — qualifier with qualified,
for helping's sake: it serves to know.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ityasti tāvadanyaśca viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyayoḥ saṃbandha upakārārthaḥ sa jñātumupayujyate

reads_against.argmap: Is there another relation? → A second relation stands: qualifier-qualified, for helping, serving knowledge.
c1_essence: Unity without strain for the consciousness-bodied; the worldly one's reflection-object fixed as difference-pithed non-difference-shining (vv10-11).
Mechanics: one thought un-touched, one word uniting many, helping relation admitted, twoness in manyness, two facings, three thinkings, genitive settling unself-lost (vv12-18).
